headline: Resolve escalations with context, not guesswork
products: Dynamics 365 for CRM, SharePoint, Microsoft Teams, Outlook
capabilities: Instantly retrieve full customer profile, interaction history, and open issues
Classify intent, detect multi‑issue cases, and score escalation risk
Match cases to playbooks and verify policy/eligibility in real time
outcomes: Reach a successful resolution in minutes, saving FTEs time
Reduce retention risk and number of future escalations
Drive higher satisfaction and loyalty with customers
Flag issues with product team based on similar cases
why_try: The demo lets a back-office agent ask a natural question and receive a source-backed, reviewable answer with the approval boundary visible in the response.

sample_prompts.label: Back-Office Agent: Inquiry triage brief
sample_prompts.prompt: I just inherited the export-error escalation. Give me the full brief before I respond.

sample_prompts.label: Back-Office Agent: Knowledge evidence search
sample_prompts.prompt: What approved guidance should I review for the customer who cannot export a long analytics range?

sample_prompts.prompt: The SSO migration case is urgent. Which queue and response target does our rulebook recommend?
